title: Regression guard: SIGTERM/SIGINT/PARENT_GONE all dispose the opencode child (#614 wiring, complements #655/PR #682 reclaim)
note: Regression contract for EXISTING behavior (commit 726a5c4 + #614b watchdog) — passes on the unmodified codebase by design; fail-first does not apply. Investigation 2026-06-11: the SIGTERM/SIGINT preventative path the follow-up task assumed was missing already exists on main; the actual gap was test coverage of the wiring.

criteria.description: process.on('SIGTERM') and process.on('SIGINT') are both registered in server.ts and route to shutdown().
shutdown() calls opencodeClient.dispose() before any process.exit, so the opencode child on :4096 is reaped on trappable terminations.
The #614b parent-PID watchdog routes through the same shutdown ('PARENT_GONE') — one shared dispose sequence for all three termination paths.
shutdown() is idempotent (shuttingDown guard); double signals cannot race two teardowns.

Live smoke: quit the Flutter app normally (Dart cleanup SIGTERMs the api_server) and confirm no `opencode serve` process remains on :4096 (lsof -iTCP:4096 -sTCP:LISTEN). SIGKILL/force-quit cases are covered by the #655 reclaim path on next launch.
